description: This file provides utility functions for handling errors, including normalizing error codes, creating standardized error objects, and formatting errors into readable strings. It is likely used across the frontend of the Tic-Tac-Toe web application to ensure consistent error handling and logging.

methods.name: normalizeErrorCode(raw)
methods.description: Normalizes a raw error code/string to one of predefined categories: VALIDATION_ERROR, BUSINESS_RULE, AUTHZ_ERROR, or ERROR.

methods.name: makeError(code, message)
methods.description: Constructs a standardized Error object with a normalized error code and message.

methods.name: formatError(err)
methods.description: Formats an error object into a readable string, ensuring consistent representation of error codes and messages.
